title: Endurance

slides.title: 28 MEN TRAPPED AT THE BOTTOM OF THE WORLD
slides.text: No radio. No rescue coming. This really happened.
1914. Explorer Ernest Shackleton sets out to cross Antarctica on foot. His ship is called Endurance.
January 1915. A day's sail from where they planned to land, the sea freezes solid around the ship. Endurance is stuck.
For ten months the ice drifts, carrying the ship with it. Winter comes, and the sun disappears.
October 1915. The ice starts to squeeze. Beams crack like gunshots. Water pours in.
They abandon ship and camp on the frozen sea. A month later, Endurance sinks. Their way home is gone.

28 men. 3 small lifeboats. Hundreds of miles from anyone.

caption: In 1915 the ice swallowed their ship. 28 men were left on the frozen sea with no radio and no rescue coming. Part 1 of 4 of one of the greatest survival stories ever. Part 2 next.
